message.reasoning_content:
need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: misappropriation of state funds, using position to divert public funds. Likely "受贿" (bribery) or "挪用公款" (embezzlement of public funds) or "职务侵占" (occupying public funds). The facts: they used position to divert national poverty alleviation special funds 60,000 (units) and got 30,000 each. That's misappropriation of public funds. In Chinese criminal law, "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds) applies to state employees who illegally appropriate public funds. Also "职务侵占罪" applies to state employees who appropriate public property. The description: "利用职务之便，伙同...将国家扶贫专项资金6万某予以私分" suggests "挪用公款罪". Also could be "贪污罪" (embezzlement). Actually "贪污罪" is for state employees who illegally take public funds for personal use. "挪用公款罪" is for misappropriation of public funds for other purposes. The facts: they diverted funds to themselves, so "贪污罪". In Chinese law, "贪污罪" (embezzlement) is for state employees who illegally appropriate public property. So answer likely "贪污罪". Could also be "受贿罪"? No, they didn't receive bribes, they misappropriated funds. So single crime: 贪污罪.

Thus output: [罪名]贪污罪<eoa>.
